summary: Coordination has pure Core/Protocol, outward GitHub adapters, a CLI and qualification-contract layer, plus separate orchestration observer, journal, runner and execution components. Current dependency policy governs seventeen source assemblies; the older solution-boundary document describes a historical smaller bootstrap set. The CLI dispatches explicit commands and ordinary settlement has source/native/check/epoch/signature/credential gates and one-use uncertainty semantics. The App remains inert; a separate orchestration Host has explicit serve configuration and its own deployment/qualification boundary. Source presence, publication, installation and live authority must be assessed separately.
title: Coordination layers, guarded CLI and separate execution surfaces
